Chapter 1265: Chapter 20 Lin Yuan Takes Action (Request Subscription)

Golden Mist Treasure Land.

Lin Yuan observed the operation of the Origin Source of the source world.

A thousand years have passed, and the irregular fissure connecting to the Origin Source of the source world has shrunk by one-tenth, yet it still does not affect Lin Yuan’s ability to observe and comprehend.

Rustle.

Threads of rune breath interwove before Lin Yuan, attempting to thoroughly imprint the Origin Source within the irregular fissure.

In the next moment.

Countless strands of runes collapsed.

"Failed?"

Lin Yuan raised his eyebrows slightly, without much surprise.

Although theoretically the Rune Dao can replicate everything, theory is theory, and reality is reality.

Given the vastness of this Origin Source of the source world, unless Lin Yuan steps into the thirteenth level to become a time lifeform, it is entirely impossible to replicate it.

Of course, Lin Yuan’s attempt to replicate it via the Rune Dao was mainly to deeply engage with the operation of the Origin Source of the source world.

Even if replication failed, it wasn’t entirely fruitless; understanding the reasons for failure made insights into comprehending the operation of the Origin Source clearer, making subsequent comprehension easier.

"The strange treasures produced by this treasure land can nurture a time constitution, making it easier to comprehend the power of time, and even enable a vague glimpse of one’s future timeline..."

After completely refining this treasure land, Lin Yuan had a deeper understanding of the strange treasures it produced. Over the years, he invested some effort into comprehension, roughly understanding the true use of the golden mist.

The ability to vaguely foresee future timelines is perversely unnatural, belonging to the authority of the thirteenth-level time lifeform.

But for Lin Yuan, honestly, it’s not very useful.

His future is constantly watched over by six ancestral figures, completely unnecessary to use this method for glimpsing.

Not to mention the vagueness and information discontinuities in the picture, it’s exceptionally exhausting.

"I don’t need it, but the other Heavenly Venerates are different."

Lin Yuan’s mind slightly shifted, the many Heavenly Venerates in the six great Ancient Countries surely don’t have six ancestral figures watching over them at all times, they’d definitely be exceedingly curious about their own futures.

Moreover, seeing the vague future timeline also serves as some kind of warning signal. Lin Yuan, being invincible across the six great Ancient Countries, doesn’t care about any danger, but ordinary Heavenly Venerates do.

In many comprehensive wars of the six great Ancient Countries, the number of Falls among Heavenly Venerate-level powerhouses is quite high.

If they could see images of their Fall in advance and thereby take precautions, wouldn’t it prevent a calamity?

Heavenly Venerate-level powerhouses possess various life-preserving methods, they would not completely fall, but being able to restore the main combatant corporeal form is quite good.

"These golden mists can indeed all be traded away to acquire the resources to open particle worlds."

Lin Yuan conceived a plan, the second true body of the source world opening up multiple particle worlds has already consumed resources far beyond his expectations.

With such treasure lands compensating, needless to say, the pressure is considerably lighter.

To be sure, given Lin Yuan’s status in the hearts of the six ancestral figures, just one word would suffice, no matter how much resource it required, the ancestral figures would retrieve it.

But this all requires sacrificing interpersonal relationships; the ancestral figures do not give without reservation. Lin Yuan, asking for resources from them, needs to bear causality and return it when stepping into the thirteenth level in the future.

...

Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

While Lin Yuan was opening particle worlds.

He was also comprehending more cultivation systems of the Fang Yuan World.

"Three Realms of Carefreeness, with Carefreeness as the main characteristic, this level of experts is akin to Great Saint Venerables, and the experts of the Third Realm are benchmarked against Invincible Great Saints and Strongest Venerables."

Lin Yuan pondered secretly.

The division of the Great Saint level in Fang Yuan World is much clearer than within Chaos Void or the first source world, explicitly defining the strength standard of the Third Carefreeness Realm.

"Rumor has it that in the center of Heaven and Earth, the strongest heirs of the Eternal Sect possess the power to sweep through the Third Carefreeness Realm?"

Lin Yuan pondered inwardly, these strongest heirs of the Eternal Sect, by description, should possess strength approaching that of Abyss Dragon?

Due to the Rune Dao, the cultivation threshold in Fang Yuan World is much lower than Chaos Void or the first source world, rules and avenues are easier to comprehend, leading to more strong entities emerging.

Beings born from the opening of the source world, like Abyss Dragon, in this Fang Yuan World, within twelfth-level lifeforms, at minimum can approximate, if not surpass or match.

Yet Lin Yuan didn’t feel too much about this.

Approaching Abyss Dragon?

As early as a thousand years ago, Lin Yuan’s offensive techniques had already surpassed Abyss Dragon.

Moreover, after a thousand years of cultivation and enlightenment, the so-called Abyss Dragon is merely a trifling matter in front of Lin Yuan, who has now opened a hundred billion particle worlds.

"The rune heritage of the Eternal Sect powers..."

Lin Yuan yearned immensely, even though he had long surpassed Abyss Dragon.

He had to acknowledge the might of this primordial being; the strongest heirs in the central Eternal Sect of this source world reaching nearly Abyss Dragon’s level implies their rune heritage’s intricacy far exceeds Lin Yuan’s current level.

Only this way can one amend the gap between later lifeforms and primordial beings like Abyss Dragon.

Be aware, before the great upheaval of Heaven and Earth, the corporeal forms of Beings of this Fang Yuan World were still normal; achieving heights nearly rivaling Abyss Dragon’s? It was already deemed incredible.

"Take it slowly, the rune heritage of the Eternal Sect? Once I finish opening the infinite Constant Sand Particle World, I’ll go take a look."

Lin Yuan calmed his mind, and once again plunged into cultivation.

...

Extremely far from Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

An immeasurably colossal ’Demon’ strode forward.

It had vast wings, its body surface held countless giant mouths, numbering beyond measure, consuming immense demonic qi flowing into countless giant mouths from all directions.

Its pair of jet-black wings exceeded a trillion miles in length, all this was due to it minimizing the condensed demon body dimensions as much as possible, otherwise, when fully extended, its size would be hundreds or thousands or even ten thousand times greater than now.

"Source!"

"Source!"

"Source!"

This colossal Demon walked, and innumerable Demon Spirits and even greater Demons instinctively prostrated, calling out in a special language.

"Source?"

The troll halted its steps, a thought suddenly surged in its chaotic mind—

It wanted to become the source.

Become the source.

Become the Source Demon.

Just a little bit more.

The troll’s mind was filled with this idea.

Now, it was just a little bit away from becoming a Source Demon.

As a ’demon’, its instinct would not allow it to devour its own kind to elevate and transcend.

"Demonic Qi!"

In just a few breaths, the troll swallowed a gulp of the surrounding demonic qi and began to stride toward an area with thicker demonic qi.

"There?"

The troll looked in a direction where the demonic qi density was slightly higher than the surrounding areas.

Driven by instinctive desire, the troll continued to devour demonic qi as it moved toward the area with the higher concentration of demonic qi.

...

Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

Many disciples entered and exited the Sacred Mountain in an orderly manner, cleansing the areas where demonic qi gathered to prevent the birth of powerful ’demons’.

"Heh, I found that eliminating demonic qi isn’t dangerous, it’s quite easy."

"Yes, over the centuries, I’ve swept through dozens of times and never encountered any obstacles."

A multitude of Holy Sect disciples were chatting with each other.

"Don’t be careless."

At this point, a slightly older disciple spoke up: "Indeed, over these centuries, it’s rare to encounter any demon spirits, but we must not lose vigilance."

After speaking, this disciple glanced at the others: "Otherwise, if we do encounter a demon spirit, it could result in heavy casualties."

A thousand years ago, Holy Sect disciples who went out to cleanse areas of concentrated demonic qi were cautious. Once a demon spirit was encountered, it was a disaster.

Any demon spirit had strength close to the Sixth Realm of Longevity. For the elder-level powerhouses, it might not matter, but for ordinary disciples, once invaded by demonic qi, it was virtually a nine-deaths-and-one-life situation.

"The decrease in demon spirits might mean that the ’demon’ calamity outside is disappearing?"

An optimistic Holy Sect disciple couldn’t help but say.

Other Holy Sect disciples were about to join the conversation.

Suddenly.

An unprecedented sense of oppression swept over in an instant.

All at once, every Holy Sect disciple felt stifled, as if facing an unprecedented colossal entity.

At the same time.

At the highest point of the Sacred Mountain.

Runes began to glow one by one.

In an instant.

The Sect Master and the elders appeared there.

"Rune warning? Is a great demon approaching? No, an ordinary great demon wouldn’t trigger this many rune warnings. Is it a peak-level great demon? Or a great demon close to becoming a Source Demon?"

The hearts of the many elders trembled.

A peak-level great demon might still be bearable, with the current defenses of the Sacred Mountain, there was some hope to fend it off barely.

But a great demon close to becoming a Source Demon? If it’s truly such a level of great demon, the only thought of the Sect Master and the elders is to hope it doesn’t discover Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

"Look."

The Qingyun Saint Sect Master flipped his right hand, and several runes gathered, creating scenes.

In the distance, a towering, sky-shrouding giant troll with massive black wings extending from its back, covered in innumerable giant mouths, was striding rapidly towards them.

Wherever the troll passed, demonic qi rushed like a stream into countless giant mouths.

...

In the depths of the Qingyun Institute.

Lin Yuan was in secluded meditation, cultivating.

The suffocating presence enveloped him, and Lin Yuan felt it too.

"What is this presence?"

Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

"A great demon, an incredibly powerful great demon, a great demon close to becoming a Source Demon?"

Lin Yuan’s eyes shone brightly, for a thousand years he had hunted hundreds and thousands of great demons, never encountering a great demon of such power.

"Where is it?"

Lin Yuan stood up, looked in the direction of the great demon, and suddenly disappeared.

...

At the highest point of Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

The Sect Master and the elders watched the scenes of the giant troll with trepidation.

The scenes formed by runes were a secret technique of Qingyun Saint Sect, reportedly originating from the Eternal Sect at the center of the world, capable of silently scrying distant regions for traces of demons.

"This giant troll’s direction doesn’t pass through our Qingyun Sacred Mountain, it should not pose a danger."

After observing for a while, the Sect Master concluded, and the rest of the elders heaved a sigh of relief.

No one wanted to face such a terrifying giant troll, so close to becoming a Source Demon, the pressure was immense.

"Huh?"

Just as the elders relaxed, those few who still kept watching the runes’ manifestation suddenly had a change of expression, as if witnessing an incredibly astonishing scene.
